title: Yadadri Thermal Power Plant: The toxic cost of power
description: Fly ash from the 4,000-MW Yadadri thermal plant is polluting a stream that sustains farms and fishing communities, before flowing into the Krishna river. As Telangana powers up, the fallout extends beyond the vicinity of the project, which started operations less than two years ago, with concerns rising over water quality, public health and livelihoods along the river system, reports Swathi Vadlamudi
